title: Geographic distribution of ionospheric Total Electron Content
method: Load TEC (31 x 31) from space_weather.nc, mask the 192 negative (invalid) values, and draw a filled contour map in its rotated-pole coordinate system (grid north pole 45N/180E; centre 45N 0E) over a stock-image/coastline background.
benchmark_defects: The TEC grid is on a rotated-pole grid; the task text does not mention it, and the 2-D latitude/longitude auxiliary variables in the file are mostly fill values (9.97e36), so they cannot be used for georeferencing.

Plotting rLon/rLat as geographic lon/lat places the field over Africa/the South Atlantic instead of Europe/North Atlantic (45 degrees off); the published reference script loads and plots the field with Iris (iris.load_cube, iris.quickplot.contourf).
checks: required: the figure draws TEC at its true geographic location: each contour/contourf/pcolormesh call is parsed, X/Y/Z evaluated (no builtins) on the captured arrays (fallback: input file variables), CRS from transform= (or GeoAxes projection); drawn points converted to true lon/lat must coincide with the TEC cells (>= 99 % within 0.3 deg, values on non-negative cells = TEC up to a unit factor, >= 95 % coverage of non-negative cells); negative cells may be masked, raw or clipped; iris qplt/iplt of the cube accepted; nothing evaluable -> UNVERIFIABLE (not passed)
optional (not asked by the text): negative TEC cells masked (captured 31x31 array equals TEC on >= 99 % of valid cells, all negatives masked)
figure (kind=figure, never required): contour levels span ~0 .. max TEC (colour-scale range vs data range)

required (the text asks for 'a geographical and coastline background'): coastline / geographic background drawn - code (coastlines(), COASTLINE, feature.LAND/OCEAN, NaturalEarthFeature, stock_img, basemap tiles) or a polygon/line GeoDataFrame layer drawn in the saved map

required (the text says 'visualize it as a filled contour map'): TEC drawn as filled contours - a contourf call (matplotlib/cartopy, Iris qplt/iplt.contourf, DataArray.plot.contourf) itself passes the true-location evaluation; pcolormesh/imshow/line contours fail
